incoming_learnings: Pool preparation must admit both a safe unknown-potion bank and an executable protected chest return. A floor supply rule is not potion identification. Preserve mandatory pickup and terminal planner exhaustion; validate a bounded ranged-clearance or nonconsumptive identification transaction before changing admission.

review.review: The Mage stopped alive at 25/25 HP because mandatory strength discovery had no admitted preparation bank, not because the game clock froze or an enemy killed it. Decision 434 (selection line 1200, accepted transition 1201) collected liquid flame; decision 435 first records it alongside unidentified azure. This changed the potion inventory after the last compatible bank observations. At decision 442 (line 1219), nearby visible banks failed preparation admission, and the remembered-bank return required an exact potion-inventory match. Its alternative reconnaissance prerequisite also declined. Source-pinned offline reconstruction matched all 442 recorded selections, including actions, reasons, intents and controllers, then reproduced the terminal blocker. Reconstructed bookkeeping retained 101 bank receipts, all for azure alone; all remained reachable in ordinary pathfinding, but none matched the new inventory. That is not proof that their transit, stash or return would be safe. The initiating planning gap is collection changing preparation requirements without an inventory-aware return transaction. No policy patch is supplied: earlier singleton feasibility does not establish collateral-separated storage and retrieval for the added potion, and bypassing inventory matching would discard that protection. Complete source browsing and reconstruction resolve the selecting-state uncertainty, but do not establish an executable replacement. Mandatory pickup, unknown-potion safety and terminal planner exhaustion must remain intact.
review.learnings: Collection can invalidate every remembered discovery bank even when the added potion is identified. Preserve pickup, but plan bounded reobservation and freshly verified remote storage for the changed inventory before allowing the preparation obligation to exhaust. Reachability alone is not preparation safety.

recommendations.summary: Establish inventory-aware reobservation and potion storage after collection invalidates discovery-bank receipts.
evidence: Decision 434: selection line 1200 and accepted transition line 1201 collect the additional potion.
Decision 435, line 1203: azure and known liquid flame are carried together.
Decision 442, line 1219: both preparation return and reconnaissance decline; mandatory discovery exhausts.
Source-pinned offline reconstruction matches decisions 0–441 and reproduces the terminal blocker; reconstructed 101 bank receipts cover azure alone.
recommendations.reason: Revalidated here, but no safe replacement is established. The exact missing safety evidence is a collateral-separated stash and retrieval plan for azure plus liquid flame at a reachable preparation area; all reconstructed receipts certify only singleton feasibility. Next derive paired decision-430/442 fixtures around banks 1146–1148 and the intervening route, then validate bounded preparation-only reobservation, fresh bank/storage admission, accepted movement accounting and return to unfinished pickup. Refuse on hazards, threats, changed inventory or failed receipts. Do not weaken inventory matching, infer azure, waive pickup or restore idle waits.
